entities.summary: St. Pantaleon Church is a Romanesque–Byzantine style church in Ukraine, in the village of Shevchenkove, Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast. The only and oldest of the churches of the Galician, and later Galician–Volhynian Principality, which has survived to this day and represents the Galician school of architecture of the medieval period. It is an architectural monument of national importance. It is a monumental cross-vaulted church with examples of exquisite white stone carving and numerous drawings and graffiti on the walls.
